text.Loyal Colony:
How to Play ==
When you play Loyal Colony you gain 3 Trade, Combat and Authority. The Loyal Colony is a base with a defense value of 6.
 Strategy Edit ==
Multipurpose base with a decent defense of 6. Everybody should understand that Adding +3 in every category is huge. Probably the highest priority for your opponents if the got the chance to destroy it. Oh what if you can put some Outpost in front of it to protect this steady income..that would be nice :).
